about: Lays a page out as a column of bands: a banner, a header, a navigation, a toolbar, a body with an optional aside, and a footer. The page measures its own width and folds its header on a narrow page.

align.about: Both alignments of a page at the narrow measure: the content at the gutter, and the content centred in the page.
align.title: Alignment

bands.about: The banner above the header, a sticky toolbar, the body with a sticky aside beside it from the `lg` breakpoint, and the footer. Below the breakpoint, this aside leaves the page.
bands.title: Bands

billingBody: The plan, the invoices and the payment methods.

context.about: The context row above the title. A wide page shows the breadcrumb trail, and a narrow page shows a single link back.
context.title: Context

divided.about: The bands with and without the hairline between them.
divided.title: Rules

everything: Everything raised for this workspace in April.

folding.about: The same page in a narrow and a wide room. On the narrow page, the meta moves under the title, the secondary action shows its icon alone, the tertiary action moves behind the folded control, and the gutter narrows.
folding.title: Folding

generalBody: The workspace's name, region and time zone.

gutter.about: Every gutter. Every band reads it.
gutter.title: Gutters

launchAbout: The campaign that opens the new billing plans.
launchBody: Twelve of twenty tasks are done.
lines: Seats, storage and support for twenty members.

measure.about: The three measures of the content: full, wide and narrow.
measure.title: Measures

membersBody: The people in the workspace and their roles.

navigation.about: The navigation band. A wide page shows a row of links, and a narrow page shows a picker that names the current section and opens the others.
navigation.title: Navigation

owed: What each of them still owes.

size.about: The three sizes. The title reads one heading size larger than a section title at the same size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Page
workspaceAbout: The usage, the seats and the limits of the workspace.
workspaceBody: Twelve of twenty seats are in use, and storage is at 40 percent.
